_meta.purpose: Canonical design tokens for this Pipemason program. Written by design-system-architect during phase: design_system. Frozen on exit. Per-story leads consume — they never edit. Updates require a follow-up design-system program iteration.
_meta.format: W3C Design Tokens Community Group draft (https://design-tokens.github.io/community-group/format/). Sibling files (tokens.css, tokens.swift, tokens.kt, tokens.ts) are GENERATED from this one — do not hand-edit them; regenerate from this source of truth.
_meta.tools: style-dictionary, theo, or hand-written generators are all fine — pick whatever the host project uses.

_meta.convention: Every color used as text-on-background must appear in DESIGN-SYSTEM.md §1 'AA-validated color pairs' with a measured contrast ratio ≥ 4.5:1 (text) or ≥ 3:1 (large text + UI). Decorative-only colors (graphics) are exempt but should be marked.
_meta.platforms: OKLCH is the source value; hex is a render approximation for tooling that doesn't grok OKLCH (legacy CSS, iOS UIColor pre-13). Generators emit both.

fg.$description: REPLACE — primary text on page bg, contrast ≥ 4.5:1

muted-fg.$description: REPLACE — text on muted surfaces, contrast ≥ 4.5:1

sans.$description: REPLACE if the brand uses a custom font

_meta.convention: 4-px or 8-px base scale. Pick one and stay consistent.
Every duration token must have a reduced-motion alternative documented in DESIGN-SYSTEM.md §5.
Hit-target minimums per platform. Web AA = 24px; iOS = 44pt; Android = 48dp.
Web only — mobile uses platform-native sizing.
